visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Append with the Pointer Idiom
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Two loops with separate indices join the strings. Write an append function that walks a pointer to the end and copies until the terminator. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: The assignment *p++ = *src++ copies one character and moves both pointers; the loop stops after copying the '\0', so the terminator is written for free. Returning dest allows chaining calls.
